name: Oda Nobunaga
source:
Hobby: Testing Others

This man only uses those who make him happy or those who are useful. As a leader, he is better at doing than speaking.

[Edited from [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/ikusa.html]English official site[/url]]
